question: When should śrāddha be performed especially after the first year?
premises: Śrāddha continues beyond the first year.
The period after one year is specified.
The ancestral fortnight is given special emphasis.
inference: After one year, śrāddha should be performed especially during the ancestral fortnight.
plain_english: After one year, the śrāddha should be performed, especially in the śrāddha fortnight.
